name: com.megvii.faceee_sdk.module.auth.RegisterFastPassAfterVerifyActivity
description: After the user verifies their account, Face++ FaceEE offers to enroll the phone's biometric or device credential for quicker future sign-in. It reports whether setup succeeds or fails.
disableEffect: Users cannot enroll or activate this FaceEE quick sign-in option on the device.
